title: Senior SDET
description:
We are seeking a **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** with strong hands-on experience in **testing AI/ML-driven applications**, preferably within the **medical or healthcare domain**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing robust test frameworks, validating AI outputs, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining high quality standards for mission-critical healthcare solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain **automated test frameworks** for AI-driven and data-intensive applications
* Validate **AI/ML models**, including:
* Input data quality
* Model outputs
* Accuracy, consistency, bias, and edge cases
* Perform **functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing** for AI tools used in medical workflows
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Developers, and Product teams to define **test strategies for AI features**
* Test **model retraining cycles**, versioning, and backward compatibility
* Ensure compliance with **healthcare regulations and standards** (HIPAA, FDA guidelines, HL7, FHIR – as applicable)
* Implement **API, backend, and UI automation testing**
* Perform **data validation testing** for large datasets and pipelines
* Conduct **performance, scalability, security, and reliability testing** for AI systems
* Participate in code reviews, test planning, defect triaging, and CI/CD pipeline integration
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior QA/SDET team members

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience as an **SDET / QA Automation Engineer**
* Strong hands-on experience in **test automation** using tools such as:
* Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar
* Proficiency in at least one programming language:
* Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Solid experience in **testing AI/ML-based applications**, including:
* Model validation
* Data-driven testing
* Explainability and accuracy checks
* Experience testing **RESTful APIs** (Postman, RestAssured, etc.)
* Strong understanding of **software testing fundamentals** and QA best practices
* Experience with **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.)
* Hands-on experience with **test data management and data validation**
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong communication skills for working with **global and cross-functional teams**

  

**Good to Have:**

* Experience in **medical / healthcare domain** projects
* Familiarity with **AI/ML concepts** (model training, inference, drift, bias)
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards such as **HL7, FHIR, DICOM**
* Experience testing **LLM-based tools**, NLP, computer vision, or decision-support systems
* Exposure to **cloud platforms** (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Understanding of **regulatory and compliance testing** in healthcare products

**About Us:**

TechAhead is **a global digital transformation company** with a strong presence in the USA and India. We specialize in **AI-first product design thinking and bespoke development solutions**. With over 15 years of proven expertise, we have partnered with **Fortune 500 companies and leading global brands** to drive digital innovation and deliver excellence. At TechAhead, we are committed to **continuous learning, growth and crafting tailored solutions** that meet the unique needs of our clients.

Join us to shape the future of digital innovation worldwide and drive impactful results with cutting-edge AI tools and strategies!

title: GTM / AI Automation Engineer
description:
***Role Overview***

The selected candidate will design, build, test, and maintain AI automation workflows for sales, marketing, lead generation, recruitment, and business operations. This is a hands-on technical role requiring practical problem-solving skills, an understanding of AI agents, and the ability to convert business requirements into working automation systems.

***Key Responsibilities***

1. AI Workflow Automation

· Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, Make, or Zapier.

· Connect applications and services to automate repetitive business tasks.

· Configure triggers, conditions, loops, data transformations, and error handling.

· Test and troubleshoot workflows to ensure reliable execution.

2. AI Agent Development

· Build AI-powered agents using Claude API, OpenAI API, and other LLM tools.

· Create prompt-based workflows, structured outputs, and tool-calling integrations.

· Develop AI workflows for lead research, qualification, content assistance, data extraction, and reporting.

· Implement human approval steps for sensitive or high-impact automated actions.

· Test AI-generated outputs for accuracy and consistency.

3. API Integration and Development

· Integrate third-party applications using REST APIs and webhooks.

· Work with JSON, API authentication, OAuth, and data mapping.

· Use Python or JavaScript for custom automation logic.

· Connect CRM platforms, databases, communication tools, and business applications.

· Debug API errors, authentication issues, and workflow failures.

4. GTM and Sales Automation

· Build automated workflows for B2B lead generation and qualification.

· Integrate tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, and approved prospecting platforms.

· Automate lead enrichment, CRM updates, follow-up tasks, and sales reporting.

· Support AI-powered account research and personalized outreach workflows.

· Maintain data quality and follow applicable privacy and communication requirements.

5. Testing and Maintenance

· Monitor workflow execution and resolve errors.

· Maintain documentation for workflows, integrations, and technical configurations.

· Optimize automation performance, API usage, and execution costs.

· Follow secure credential-management practices.

· Collaborate with team members to deliver projects on time.

***Required Technical Skills***

· 1–3 years of experience in workflow automation, software development, API integrations, or AI automation.

· Practical knowledge of n8n, Make, or Zapier.

· Experience using Claude API, OpenAI API, or similar LLM services.

· Basic to intermediate Python or JavaScript.

· Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and authentication.

· Knowledge of prompt engineering and AI workflow design.

· Strong debugging, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

***Good-to-have skills***

· Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho CRM.

· Familiarity with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and AI agent frameworks.

· Experience with PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, Slack, or Google Workspace integrations.

· Knowledge of Docker, cloud platforms, and workflow monitoring.

· Understanding of sales, marketing, and business process automation.

***Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)***

· Successful development and deployment of assigned automation workflows.

· Accuracy and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

· Reduction in repetitive manual tasks.

· Timely completion of development tasks.

· Number and quality of successfully deployed integrations.

· Reduction in workflow errors and recurring failures.

· Quality of documentation and troubleshooting.

Pay: ₹325,000.00 - ₹720,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Work from home

Work Location: In person
